k2_support_bounds._rationale: Physical-k2 support guard, IDENTICAL box to titan_freegrav_noocean.json / test54_titan_nh3_freegrav.json / test54_titan_nacl_freegrav.json (scientific-reviewer a2d7f121). Fluid-limit secular Love ceiling k2<=3/2 => Re_k2 in [-0.1,1.5]; dissipation cannot exceed elastic response => |Im_k2| in [0,1.0]. Applied to the NOISELESS forward output before obs noise (imag_convention='abs' globally), counted as a support rejection so SBI training support == reference-MCMC effective support. Physics-anchored, NOT tuned to pass. In the JOINT posterior this box ADMITS frozen no-ocean nodes into the likelihood-disfavored low-k2 tail rather than support-rejecting them.

metadata.schema_version: titan_freegrav_v1 ocean (MgSO4) JOINT no-ocean+ocean posterior — test54_titan_mgso4_freegrav
metadata.description: Titan free-gravity SBI campaign, MgSO4-ocean interior model, Phase B of the Titan free-gravity plan (plans/fluffy-snacking-fountain.md). JOINT no-ocean + ocean posterior (same mechanism as the ratified NH3 artifact test54_titan_nh3_freegrav.json, Task #68): frozen (cold) nodes build as REAL no-ocean interiors (retry_frozen_as_no_ocean=True; comp='MgSO4' kept so the Margules liquidus sets the HP-ice temperature profile) and appear in the posterior. Interior priors, derived rho_sil (mass conservation), rheology/thermal parameter space, gravity channel, and observable vector are IDENTICAL to titan_freegrav_noocean.json / the NH3 & NaCl joint configs (reviewer action item 3: consistent dissipation across all interior models). Differences vs NH3/NaCl: (1) comp='MgSO4' (Choukroun-Grasset density + Margules phase, phaseType='lookup' = uncapped Pmax=inf, acc725ea R2), (2) Tb_K = the MgSO4 monotone-onset band [248,258] K (the genuine ~250 K nearly-FLAT onset, NOT NaCl's tilted [233,272] diagonal), (3) log10_wOcean_ppt upper bound = log10(194)=2.2878 (2-molal MgSO4 cap), (4) a MgSO4 2D (Tb x w) structure cache, (5) phase_stability.enforce DROPPED.
metadata.reference: Petricca et al. (2025), Nature 648:558 (gravity C20/C22, k2, MoI); interior parameterization from test52. MgSO4 ocean EOS: PP MgSO4 (Choukroun-Grasset 2010 density + Margules liquidus); no SeaFreeze MgSO4 EOS is installed so comp='MgSO4' always routes to HydroEOS.py MgSO4 path.

salinity_axis_2026_08_06.ceiling_rationale: MgSO4 2-molal cap: 2 mol/kg * 0.12037 / (1 + 2*0.12037) * 1000 = 194.1 ppt (mass fraction of solution). log10(194)=2.2878. Campaign spec lower limit 1 ppt. Prior uniform in log10 w (Jeffreys).

metadata.phase_stability_dropped_reason: phase_stability.enforce is NOT set (contrast titan_freegrav_noocean.json 'no_ocean_Ih'). Omitting it admits BOTH the frozen no-ocean regime and the ocean regime into the joint posterior. density_inversion_guard + k2_support_bounds still apply uniformly.
metadata.mgso4_margules_island_exclusion_2026_08_: The MgSO4 phase diagram has a PATHOLOGICAL low-Tb ocean 'island' at the w=194 (2-molal) cap: ocean at Tb=239-240, frozen 242-249, ocean 250+ (onset probe). Scientific-reviewer (a3c9ed8ae24664527, 2026-08-06) adjudicated it a Margules-lookup MELTING-MONOTONICITY VIOLATION (at fixed P=215 MPa, a stable liquid at 239 K refreezes to ice III at 240.5 K — thermodynamically impossible), present ONLY at exactly w=194 (the free-energy crossover evaluated at the 2-molal validity edge, MgSO4Props.py::MgSO4PhaseMargules). It is NOT physical re-entrant melting. EXCLUDED from the training cache by construction: the Tb grid places NO nodes below 248 K at w>=180 ppt (fine band across the monotone ~250 K onset only). A post-build invariant asserts no cached node with w>=180 & Tb<248 carries has_ocean=True — necessary because retry_frozen_as_no_ocean triggers only on NoIceLiquidTransitionError and the island nodes build SUCCESSFULLY as phantom oceans (they do not raise). See project_mgso4_margules_island memory + /tmp/titan_probe/mgso4_island_finecheck.json.
metadata.extrap_ocean_2026_08_06: extrap_ocean=True (NOT a no-op for MgSO4, contrast NaCl). The MgSO4 density table (EOS2_MgSO4_planetary_smaller) Pmax=800 MPa, but the deep w=194 ocean nodes reach P_basal ~1276-1371 MPa on the production PPTitan (core+porous-rock) template. Reviewer (a3c9ed8ae24664527, 2026-08-06) adjudicated extrap_ocean=True (RegularGridInterpolator linear extrapolation) over flat clamp: the linear extrap is physically sound (monotone rho, smoothly stiffening K_T 8699->9807 MPa over 800-1400, projection error ~1.5% at 1371 MPa water-benchmarked), whereas the clamp imposes an unphysical zero-compressibility density floor on ~500 km of deep brine. A hard 1400 MPa extrapolation CEILING rejects (stores None) any ocean node beyond it (fences runaway); nodes 800-1200 MPa flagged eos_extrapolated='mild', 1200-1400 MPa flagged 'deep' (~1-1.5% error); a post-build dρ/dP-in-[0.14,0.17]-band invariant catches defective columns. Every ocean struct carries P_basal_ocean_MPa. The w~194 tail of the posterior is entirely extrapolation-supported — carry this caveat in any high-salinity science claim.
